question: Since Subaru was able to crush the Lion’s Heart, in a situation where Betelgeuse knew the details of that ability, would he be able to easily defeat Regulus? Or is it simply that his ability is well-suited to it?
answer: If you know the details of the ability, it’s simply a matter of killing all the brides, so even if you’re not Mr. Bete, you can win. How you arrive at that point is the problem.
